description: Turn off one alert in the person's own linked PermitSnag account, by the alert id list_my_alerts gives. PermitSnag stops checking it and sends no more openings for it; it can be turned back on from the website. It never cancels a booking, a permit application or a paid plan. Turning off an alert that is already off changes nothing.
name: cancel_alert

outputSchema.description: Whether the alert was turned off, was already off, or the reason the request was refused.

reason.description: Why the request was refused, as a short code.

title: Turn off a PermitSnag alert
